exact-offer-cost-route-baseline-2026-09-03.json: source of every row carried forward unchanged below (the ten archived cn-direct rows, the four compression rows, and the eight retired watch-roll rows). None of those were re-read today.

notes.2026-09-09: Nine bamboo lighting rows added. Only TWO of them are approved for the United States: hand-woven-bamboo-pendant-light and plug-in-bamboo-sconce-swing-arm, whose listings state Voltage 90-260V. The other seven all come off listing 1005009170603754, whose specification table states Voltage 220 V, and are held in VOLTAGE_HOLD_CATALOG_OFFERS rather than approved. Their cost and route rows are kept here so that releasing them needs a supplier confirmation rather than a fresh audit. See the hold comment in app/lib/launch-catalog.js.
notes.2026-09-09-routes: All three listings quote the same carrier and price into the United States: AliExpress Selection Standard at $1.99, CN-direct. The two delivery windows differ (Sep 15-20 at 84.0% within 10 days for 1005007626643748; Sep 16-21 at 87.5% within 12 days for the other two, which returned an identical distribution). tracked:true is carried from the carrier identity recorded in the 2026-09-01 baseline, NOT from a tracking number observed today - that needs a placed order.
notes.2026-09-09-fx: Fee rates, planning FX and checkout shipping carried forward from 2026-09-03 unchanged. Nothing about the Shopify delivery profile was re-read today.
notes.2026-09-10: FIVE offers approved for the United States, up from two. One is a re-map that fixed a live mis-ship (the 36cm pendant was mapped to a wide-brim hat shade while all its photography showed a wave saucer); one is the dome coming off the voltage hold, not by answering its 220 V question but by finding the same shade on a 90-260V listing with 598 units instead of one; two are new. The voltage hold therefore drops from seven offers to six, and the pattern that released the dome is the one to try on the remaining six.
notes.2026-09-10-duty: The plan for settling US_DUTY_INCIDENCE was wrong and is corrected in app/lib/launch-catalog.js. The DSers 'Tax&Fee' line, which three documents named as the thing a first real order would read, is a Tmall tax-and-service-fee field per its own tooltip. It reads $0.00 for every AliExpress marketplace supplier whatever the duty does, and the old instruction was to read $0.00 as 'prepaid' - a false confirmation of the profitable scenario, bought with a real order. Nothing in this file was set from that field.
notes.2026-09-10-rule-2: woven-rattan-petal-pendant-30cm carries openGate rule-2-dsers-stable-cost-unconfirmed. Its cost is a page reading only. Every other row in the bamboo block has been reconciled against a DSers stable cost, and on one supplier the page understated the DSers cost by a consistent $1.97 per SKU.
notes.2026-09-10-transit: FREIGHT COST AND TRANSIT TIME ARE SEPARATE FACTS. Every offer here quotes $1.99 to the United States, which read as one uniform cheap line for weeks. It is not one line. Read per SKU from the DSers Shipping info panel: Style B-Black Base and Style F-Wood Base are AliExpress Selection Standard at 8-14 days; Style C on the same listing is 7-12; the petal's Warm Light-30CM is AliExpress Selection Shipping_OVERSIZED at 33-41 days. Same price, four times the wait. The petal is now held on that reading. Read the LINE and the DAYS, per SKU, not just the cost.
